limits: Original-face local convex-corner profiles, not a minimum wall guarantee. Tiny first chords approaching vertices are retained; no summation over later air gaps. Entry face14622 spans beyond entry height; its centroid is not an entry-only result.

16042.profile_method: Move from short-edge midpoint toward opposite vertex by fraction, offset in short-edge direction. Project to actual first surface from 1mm exterior along reference face normal; then use true cross normal of hit original facet. Offsets can change facets; no claim all shifts lie in original narrow face.
